messages:
Maria P.: Hey team — quick sync to get AWS/GCP/Azure publisher accounts and infra access sorted for the upcoming listing. Need a checklist and owners.
Devon Y.: I can take AWS publisher portal onboarding + IAM roles. Need account email and publisher org id from partners.
Samir K.: I’ll own GCP + test image hosting. Can someone confirm S3 bucket naming convention? prefer `redwood-marketplace-<env>-<region>`
Alex R.: Confirmed for S3. Also we need trial SKU mapping and a sample pricing tier doc from product. @Priya can you confirm legal docs (EULA + data processing addendum) are up-to-date for all three clouds?
Priya (Legal): EULA/DPA are ready but need publisher legal name and jurisdiction. Also flag: Azure requires a localized terms checkbox in the publisher portal — will provide copy.
Devon Y.: For AWS IAM, propose a cross-account role `MarketplacePublisherRole` with the following minimal policy:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject","sts:AssumeRole"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-marketplace-*"}]
}
```
Samir K.: For GCP I’ll create a service account with Storage Admin on the test bucket and Pub/Sub Publisher for usage events. Will document steps in the playbook.
Maria P.: Timeline: want publisher portal access by EOD Wed, trial SKUs + pricing by Thu, and legal sign-off by Fri. Is that realistic?
Alex R.: EOD Wed workable if partners provide publisher org id and admin email by tomorrow morning. I can do the portal invites.
Priya (Legal): I can sign off by Fri if I get final publisher legal name + data residency requirements today.
MarketplaceBot: Submitted ticket #MP-4821 for AWS publisher invite — use this thread for updates. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/MP-4821
Devon Y.: Action items assigned: Devon -> AWS IAM + portal invites; Samir -> GCP buckets + test image; Alex -> publisher portal invites & azure preflight; Maria -> consolidate partner contact details + trial SKU mapping; Priya -> legal copy and Azure localized terms.
Maria P.: I’ll DM partners for org ids now and drop list here when done. Quick note — partners asked about Marketplace listing thumbnail size (Azure wants 1920x1080, AWS prefers 1280x720). Can design team provide both?
Alex R.: Pinged design, they said can deliver two sizes by tomorrow noon.
Samir K.: I’ll also spin up a small test instance to validate billing metering events end-to-end.
Maria P.: Great — thanks all. I’ll post updates here. :thumbsup:
